author: John Hammond
description:
I've been experimenting with using Minecraft as an interface for malware research. I bring a hunt-derived sample into a contained sandbox, keep the VM running, and interact with the environment through an agent.

It's a pretty unusual workflow, but that's part of the fun.

Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/xGpIgLJ9ZIM?si=QfVBu1PH3FGhuBzc
title: Minecraft Malware Research
